paragraphs: [Ketubot 46a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.46a.13) mentions Rav Yosef Tzidoni reciting a baraita of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai. Yuchasin places him in Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak’s time because Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak reports that Rav Yosef Tzidoni also taught the point. Hyman says Seder HaDorot erred on this point; see Rabbi Yose Tzaydenaya.

notes.text: ארנב״י expands to Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said; it is not a name Arnabi. Hyman glosses bei as a baraita of Shimon ben Yochai. The chronological argument and criticism of Seder HaDorot remain his.

The consulted Ketubot 46a supplies the reciter and reporting formula. The exact Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot discussions were not independently inspected here, and the historical inference remains Hyman’s.

In [Ketubot 46a:13](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.46a.13), Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak introduces a parallel teaching attributed to Rav Yosef Tzidoni. The consulted English takes bei to mean “in the school of” Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai. Hyman expands it as “a baraita of” Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai.
